verdict.rationale: Cloudflare touts billing that 'even during long agent workflows or hibernating WebSockets' charges only for compute (cloudflare-docs-6), implying support for durable workflows, but there is no evidence of a dedicated workflow/queue/retry orchestration primitive in the pack, and community feedback explicitly states CPU time limits 'don't work for long-running agent tasks,' pushing developers toward self-hosting instead (cloudflare-comm-9).
